achievements.name: The Call
achievements.detail: Begin in Silver Pines after the phone call that sends Red Walker to find Eddie Velvet.

achievements.name: Map Photo
achievements.detail: Photograph a blocked door or odd object so that spot stays marked on your map.

achievements.name: Box Cutter
achievements.detail: Cut open a tied tarp with the box cutter and walk into the space behind it.

achievements.name: Motel Gate
achievements.detail: Read Eddie's code from the Crimson Bear guest ledger, then enter it at the motel gate.

achievements.name: Snub Revolver
achievements.detail: Take the revolver from the Grizzly Suite and fire it in a fight.

achievements.name: Motel Shotgun
achievements.detail: Open the weapon locker in the motel gift shop and leave with the shotgun.

achievements.name: Hip Bag
achievements.detail: Pick up a hip bag and gain the extra inventory slots it adds.

achievements.name: Coffee Break
achievements.detail: Drink from a coffee jug to bring your stamina back during a long search.

achievements.name: Mixed Tonic
achievements.detail: Combine herbs with an empty bottle to mix a tonic for your inventory.

achievements.name: Quick Repair
achievements.detail: Patch a worn melee weapon with duct tape or a repair kit so it can be swung again.

achievements.name: Payphone
achievements.detail: Spend a coin at a payphone and save your progress from that call.

achievements.name: Sledgehammer
achievements.detail: Smash through a cracked wall with the sledgehammer and take the path beyond it.

achievements.name: Cable Car
achievements.detail: Hang the station bells, ring the marked sequence, and ride the cable car up the line.
